english: The currency GOLD is yang, REPUTATION reputation points. The cost in items is vnum,count pairs separated by commas, e.g. 50255,3 (3 of item 50255); 4 pairs at most, as the db core reads no more, every item must be in item_proto, and an empty field is a purchase without items. The core reads the cost when it starts: the change works after “Apply”.
polski: Waluta GOLD to yang, REPUTATION - punkty reputacji. Koszt w przedmiotach to pary vnum,ilość rozdzielone przecinkami, np. 50255,3 (3 sztuki przedmiotu 50255); najwyżej 4 pary, bo rdzeń db czyta tylko tyle, każdy przedmiot musi być w item_proto, a puste pole oznacza zakup bez przedmiotów. Rdzeń czyta koszt przy starcie: zmiana działa po „Zastosuj”.
translation: The currency GOLD is yang, REPUTATION reputation points. The cost in items is vnum,count pairs separated by commas, e.g. 50255,3 (3 of item 50255); 4 pairs at most, as the db core reads no more, every item must be in item_proto, and an empty field is a purchase without items. The core reads the cost when it starts: the change works after “Apply”.
